master.prompt: Gunmetal grey heavy-haul prime mover coupled to THREE-axle multi-axle lowbed with hydraulic gooseneck hitch, carrying yellow tracked excavator chained down, folded boom and bucket on deck. Heavy grime and chipped paint. Exactly SIX ROAD axles TOTAL: THREE on tractor (rear tandem and front steering), THREE on lowbed at left. Identical 1.20m highway rib tread road tires on ALL six axles. Entire rig and load one image. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching approved Swamp Scout. Readable dark contours, richly textured weathered materials and fine mechanical detail, soft even daylight. Facing RIGHT, cab front face NOT visible, only sliver of roof. True alpha transparent background with clean neutral edges, NO coloured fringe, halo, checkerboard, ground, shadow, text, logos or watermark. Every near-side tire fully visible, perfectly circular with centred rim, hub centres horizontal and bottoms level. Chassis/deck/load horizontal. Full object with generous 5% clear margins on all sides. Very wide lowbed composition 3300x1000. Exactly SIX equal road wheels: THREE at far left lowbed rear, TWO behind tractor cab, ONE steering under cab/hood at right. No extra road wheels under low deck.
